name: Demo Extension Rules
description: The code-analysis rules for the demo extension. Add a justification for each rule you change.

rules.justification: The FlowField <> of <> should be added to the SIFT key.
The ID range is inside 50000..99999 (per-tenant range), not an AppSource range. AppSourceCop reports it by design.
Marketplace manifest properties (privacyStatement, EULA, help, logo, contextSensitiveHelpUrl) are required for AppSource submission only. This is a per-tenant extension.
The publisher url is an AppSource listing requirement. This is a per-tenant extension.
A mandatory prefix or suffix is an AppSource requirement. A per-tenant extension has no reserved affix.
Application Insights telemetry is not configured for this demo per-tenant extension.
